input.quote: 12.3 Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-solicitation or no-hire covenant binding Customer. Searches for "solicit", "employ", "hire", "induce" and "personnel" return no restrictive covenant on Customer's hiring; § 30 (General), § 16 (Confidentiality) and § 12 contain none. To the contrary, § 12.3 affirmatively preserves Customer's freedom to hire any person responding to general recruitment and records that Customer has made no no-hire commitment. This meets the preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer) and benefits our party, so no redline is proposed. Note that § 12.4 restricts Vendor only (competing-service development), which is in our favour and is not addressed by this rule.
